name: INDUSTRY 13 Karaoke & Bar
description: Industry 13 is a modern and upscale karaoke venue offering private rooms with high-tech equipment, including Korean, Mandarin, and YouTube karaoke systems. The atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming, with a focus on quality sound, a wide song selection, and excellent food and drinks. Open until 5am, it’s perfect for late-night fun, special celebrations, or casual nights out with friends. The staff is friendly, attentive, and dedicated to providing a memorable experience.
